blocks.text: President Lee Jae Myung’s attendance at a series of as energy crisis raises stakes for bloc ties-related summits comes at a time when the US-Iran war has exposed a shared vulnerability across South Korea and Southeast Asia: their reliance on the Middle East for energy supplies. Lee is set to arrive in Manila, the Philippines, on Monday for the South Korea-Asean and South Korea-Mekong summits, followed by the Asean Plus Three summit and his first East Asia Summit on Tuesday. Lee stressed the importance of deepening South Korea’s ties with the 11-member Southeast Asian bloc in a written interview with a […]...
